description: Y.A.N.A es un sistema ciberfísico de asistencia integral para astronautas que permita monitorear su bienestar físico y psicológico, brindar acompañamiento cotidiano, facilitar la comunicación con sus familiares, generar informes periódicos para los equipos de apoyo en la tierra (respetando la privacidad y autonomía del astronauta) y avisar los posibles problemas que pueden aparecer en la nave.
summary:
Y.A.N.A. (Your Astronaut Needs Assistant) es una propuesta de asistente robótico diseñado para brindar apoyo a los astronautas durante misiones espaciales de larga duración. El proyecto integra inteligencia artificial, interacción por voz, monitoreo del bienestar, gestión de actividades y herramientas de comunicación.
Y.A.N.A. aborda los desafíos del aislamiento, las exigencias de la vida en el espacio y las dificultades para mantener rutinas organizadas, ofreciendo recordatorios, seguimiento voluntario del bienestar, informes periódicos y comunicación con familiares. Además, puede proporcionar notificaciones autorizadas sobre el estado de la nave espacial.
Su importancia radica en que busca mejorar la experiencia cotidiana de los astronautas, facilitar sus actividades y ofrecer acompañamiento tecnológico, complementando el apoyo de la tripulación y los sistemas existentes, sin reemplazarlos.
details: Y.A.N.A. is a fixed robotic assistant designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions. It combines artificial intelligence, voice interaction, visual expressions, well-being monitoring, and activity management. The system is designed to answer questions, provide reminders, organize daily schedules, record voluntary well-being information, generate periodic reports, and facilitate communication with family members through authorized spacecraft communication systems. Its main benefits include helping astronauts maintain organized routines, supporting their daily well-being, reducing the difficulties associated with isolation, and providing easier access to relevant information. The expected impact is to improve the crew's daily experience and complement existing human and technological support systems. The project builds on a physical prototype developed using a Raspberry Pi 3B+, two SH110X OLED displays, three MG90S servomotors, a microphone, a speaker, and experimental sensor modules. Python was used for Raspberry Pi programming. The application interface was developed using CodePen, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Y.A.N.A.'s creativity lies in combining robotics and artificial intelligence with a human-centered approach. Its friendly, oval-shaped design, inspired by EVE from WALL-E, makes technological interaction more approachable. Its proposed hybrid architecture also allows essential functions to operate locally when connectivity is unavailable. During development, the team considered several important factors, including astronaut safety, microgravity, limited space, power consumption, material compatibility, data privacy, cybersecurity, and communication availability. The project is currently a conceptual space-adaptation proposal; its prototype is intended for ground development and demonstration, not as a flight-certified device.
